message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Moin, you did your homework with the material index and that other quote, I have to admit. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. The 14 days payment is good for us, so I'm willing to meet you at €30.00 for the 35 days lead time. That beats your other guy and keeps the machines running, so let's get this done. So we offer a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
